# Round 3 -- the cases the first 97 queries cannot see.
#
# EVALUATION_AUDIT.md sections 3 and 4 fixed two real preprocessing defects:
# the tokeniser destroyed alphanumeric biomedical identity, and negation was
# dropped inconsistently. Neither could be measured, because not one of the 97
# queries contains a digit or a trial code and only one is negation-shaped.
# These queries exist to make those fixes measurable. Three strata, scored
# separately -- they are different retrieval tasks and averaging them would
# hide all three.
#
# S1 -- alphanumeric entity identity. Chosen as COLLAPSE PAIRS: under the old
# digit-stripping chain IL-6/IL-1 both become "il", CD4/CD8 both become "cd",
# SARS-CoV-1/SARS-CoV-2/MERS-CoV all shed their distinguishing token. If the
# fix does anything, it is here that it shows.
IL-6 inhibitor for cytokine storm
IL-1 blockade in covid-19
CD4 T cell response
CD8 T cell response
SARS-CoV-2 neutralising antibody
MERS-CoV and SARS-CoV-1 comparison
BNT162b2 vaccine trial
mRNA-1273 vaccine immunogenicity
ChAdOx1 nCoV-19 vaccine
ACE2 receptor expression
D-dimer levels and thrombosis
vitamin D3 supplementation
#
# S2 -- known-item retrieval by registry code. Ground truth here needs no
# judgement: a document is relevant iff its text contains the code. All three
# codes are cited by OTHER trials (companion and extension studies), never
# self-references, so this measures retrieval and not row lookup.
NCT04446429
NCT04317092
NCT04372368
#
# S3 -- negation, as four PAIRS. Each negated query is preceded by its
# positive control. The pair is the measurement: if a system returns the same
# documents for "hospitalized" and "non-hospitalized", it does not represent
# negation, and that is visible from rank overlap before any judging happens.
hospitalized patients with covid-19
non-hospitalized patients with covid-19
patients requiring supplemental oxygen
patients not requiring supplemental oxygen
severe covid-19 pneumonia
non-severe covid-19 pneumonia
treatment with mechanical ventilation
treatment without mechanical ventilation
